Neonix Infra Solutions — Clean & Green Energy Solutions in India

India's trusted rooftop solar panel installation specialists. We design and install high-efficiency grid-tied solar systems for residential homes, commercial enterprises, and industrial facilities with up to ₹78,000 direct subsidy support under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.

Our Solar Services & Solutions

  • Residential Rooftop Solar: Cut household electricity bills by up to 90% with Tier-1 Mono PERC & TopCon solar panels, net metering, and instant government subsidy up to ₹78,000.
  • Commercial Solar Energy: Reduce operating power overhead for offices, hospitals, schools, and retail establishments with accelerated 40% depreciation tax benefits.
  • Industrial Solar Power: Turnkey high-capacity solar plants for factories and warehouses with guaranteed continuous generation and custom load design.
  • Solar Care & Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC): Scheduled panel cleaning, electrical inspection, generation monitoring, and rapid repair support for 30+ year lifespan.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much government subsidy is available for rooftop solar panels?
Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, residential consumers receive up to ₹78,000 direct central subsidy (₹30,000 for 1kW, ₹60,000 for 2kW, and ₹78,000 for 3kW+).
How much can I save on my electricity bill?
A standard rooftop solar installation can reduce monthly electricity bills by up to 90%. Excess green energy is exported back to the grid via net metering.
What is the lifespan of Neonix solar panels?
Neonix installs Tier-1 Mono PERC and TopCon solar panels with a 25-30 year performance warranty.

We install third-party manufactured equipment (such as solar panels and inverters). Warranties for these products are provided directly by their respective manufacturers. Neonix Infra Solutions guarantees the quality of our installation workmanship for a specific period outlined in your personalized service agreement.

While we eagerly assist in applying for the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidies and DISCOM net metering, the final approval, disbursement times, and regulatory changes remain at the sole discretion of the government and local electrical authorities.
